top_findings.title: Live server never initializes the books table — schema created on a discarded connection
top_findings.evidence: src/main.rs:79 binds `db` to a fresh open_in_memory() whose schema is never created; src/main.rs:80 runs TABLE_DEF via models::create_connection("in-memory") on a separate file-backed connection (SQLite open() treats "in-memory" as a path, not :memory:) and discards it with .ok(); src/main.rs:82 wraps the schema-less `db` into app state. The on-disk `in-memory` SQLite artifact (verified: contains a `books` table) is that discarded connection's output. Every live /books route errors with `no such table: books`. Tests pass because each builds its own initialized connection.
top_findings.suggestion: Run conn.execute_batch(models::TABLE_DEF) on `db` before wrapping it (or bind db_data to the connection create_connection returns); a persistent file path would also satisfy the 'not just in-memory state' clause.
